## Research interests

Artificial neural networks, (bio)medical image analysis, machine learning,
computer vision, and computing education.

## Projects and funding

| Period | Project |
|---|---|
| 2023 – ongoing | **PI** — Optical coherence tomography (and angiography) scans and deep-learning-based Alzheimer's disease diagnosis. TÜBİTAK-ARDEB, 1M TL |
| 2018 – 2022 | **PI** — Artificial focusing neuron model and method to learn topology in neural networks. TÜBİTAK-ARDEB, 280K TL |
| 2014 – 2017 | **PI** — Omni-directional tele-presence robot. Işık University internal grant, ~50K TL |
| 2013 | TÜBİTAK-BİDEP visiting research grant, HCI Heidelberg |

Earlier work includes object detection by interactive learning, autonomous model
vehicles and quadcopters (Işık University), nucleus detection in SEM mouse brain
imagery (HCI Heidelberg), colon and lung CAD (MedicSight), *Xenopus laevis*
identification, automated malaria diagnosis (Westminster), and firearms
identification and face detection (TÜBİTAK-BİLTEN).

## Teaching

Introduction to Data Science and Engineering · Optimization for Data Science ·
Artificial Intelligence · Neural Networks and Deep Learning · Computer Vision ·
Pattern Recognition · Computer Organization and Architecture · Microprocessors
